event.title: Tech Innovation Meetup
event.description: Join us for an evening of innovation, networking, and collaboration with tech leaders from across the Bay Area.

whatToExpect.intro: An engaging evening of tech talks, networking, and hands-on demos from leading innovators.
whatToExpect.content:
This meetup brings together developers, designers, and entrepreneurs to share ideas and build connections.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn from industry experts
  • Network with fellow tech professionals
  • Participate in hands-on workshops
  • Enjoy refreshments and socialize

venue.name: CloudPeers Innovation Center
venue.description: A modern event space designed for collaboration and creativity.
venue.parking: Street parking available. Garage parking at 456 Market Street.

speakers.name: Dr. Sarah Chen
speakers.title: AI Research Lead at TechCorp
speakers.bio: Sarah leads AI research at TechCorp with a focus on natural language processing and machine learning systems. She holds a PhD in Computer Science from Stanford.

speakers.name: Marcus Rodriguez
speakers.title: Principal Engineer at CloudScale
speakers.bio: Marcus has 15 years of experience building distributed systems. He's passionate about developer tools and open source software.

speakers.name: Emma Thompson
speakers.title: VP of Engineering at StartupXYZ
speakers.bio: Emma leads engineering teams and has scaled startups from seed to Series B. She's an advocate for engineering culture and mentorship.
